title: Motion
scenario: PageHost slide, Tree expand and collapse, toggle/checkbox/slider state changes, popup open and close, all with motion enabled, sampled at 30/60/144/240 Hz. Proves G14, G7. 480x360 at 96 DPI, dark theme, motion enabled; one phase per transition and rate, each a 400 ms window on the frozen fixture clock (step 0 the state change, then one tick and frame per sample); a last 60 Hz phase slides out a page holding an indeterminate ProgressBar. ComboBox popup only: MenuPopup needs a native window.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers
